name: Circle Of Death
materials: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP
description: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere from a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.\nUsing a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The damage increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 6.\n
